mentions.name: vpdf
mentions.description: This app is a vim-inspired terminal PDF reader built on MuPDF and the Kitty Graphics Protocol, letting users read PDFs in the terminal with vim keybindings.
mentions.problem: The author wanted vim bindings for reading PDFs, which conventional PDF readers lack.
mentions.source_excerpt: A vim-inspired terminal PDF reader using MuPDF and Kitty Graphics Protocol, mostly for my personal use since I want to use vim bindings for reading PDFs.
mentions.author: letientai299
